attributes.content:
**EL-HAZ-1.4.2 Rear turn lamps follow ReqLeft and ReqRight**

DEVS2_Lighting shall light Lamp_RearLeftTurn while ReqLeft is 1 and Lamp_RearRightTurn while ReqRight is 1, as received in each DEVMLIN01Fr01 frame.

It shall add no flashing, filtering or timing of its own.

description: Allocated to building block DEVS2 in RearLight. DEVS2 drives the rear turn lamps. Following ReqLeft/ReqRight as written by RLCM closes the chain from TurnLightControl to the rear lamps.
